integrity: All universal statements are proved symbolically from affine equivariance, the exact Minkowski polynomial of boxes, weighted Cauchy--Schwarz, and elementary symmetric polynomials. The included exact-rational checker is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to equal-volume origin-symmetric parallelotopes with a common normal fan. It does not prove the generalized-radii conjecture for arbitrary three-dimensional convex bodies and does not classify non-sharp admissible generalized-radius pairs. The lead conjecture is very recent, so an unindexed duplicate calculation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact generalized-radii witnesses for common-facet parallelotopes
